exercises.title: Nested FOR Loops
exercises.description: Use a FOR loop inside another FOR loop.
instructions: Create outer loop: FOR ${i} IN RANGE 3
Inside it, create inner loop: FOR ${j} IN RANGE 2
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Nested Loops
    # Write nested FOR loops
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Nested Loops
    FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    3
        FOR    ${j}    IN RANGE    2
            Log    ${i}-${j}
        END
    END
hints: Inner loop has 12-space indentation (triple indent)
Each loop needs its own END
Inner END before outer END
Outer loop runs 3 times, inner runs 2 times each

exercises.title: FOR with IF
exercises.description: Combine FOR loop with conditional logic.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Conditional Loop
    # Write FOR loop with IF
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Conditional Loop
    ${numbers}    Create List    1    2    3    4    5
    FOR    ${num}    IN    @{numbers}
        IF    ${num} > 3
            Log    Greater: ${num}
        END
    END
hints: IF inside FOR requires 12-space indentation
IF body needs 16-space indentation
Both IF and FOR need END
Should log for numbers 4 and 5

exercises.title: BREAK and CONTINUE
exercises.description: Control loop execution with BREAK and CONTINUE.
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Loop Control
    # Write loop with BREAK and CONTINUE
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Loop Control
    FOR    ${i}    IN RANGE    10
        IF    ${i} == 3
            CONTINUE
        END
        IF    ${i} == 7
            BREAK
        END
        Log    ${i}
    END
hints: CONTINUE skips rest of current iteration
BREAK exits the loop immediately
CONTINUE and BREAK at same indentation as Log
Useful for complex loop logic

exercises.title: WHILE Loop
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
While Loop Test
    # Write WHILE loop
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
While Loop Test
    ${count}    Set Variable    0
    WHILE    ${count} < 3
        Log    Count: ${count}
        ${count}    Evaluate    ${count} + 1
    END
hints: WHILE continues as long as condition is true
Must update condition variable inside loop
Syntax: WHILE <condition>
Don't forget END

exercises.title: TRY-EXCEPT Error Handling
instructions: Inside, use Should Be Equal to compare 1 and 2 (will fail)
exercises.initialCode:
*** Test Cases ***
Error Handling
    # Write TRY-EXCEPT block
exercises.solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Error Handling
    TRY
        Should Be Equal    1    2
    EXCEPT
        Log    Error caught
    END
hints: TRY block contains code that might fail
EXCEPT catches errors and prevents test failure
Can specify error types: EXCEPT ErrorType
ELSE block runs if no error occurred
